items.text: — MacBooks show live charge % via direct IOKit reads (backport from v8.3.12 Beta; fixes — % / desktop on laptops).
— MacBooks now show live charge % via direct IOKit AppleSmartBattery reads (fixes — % / desktop / N/A when pmset subprocesses fail).
— battery polling always runs at launch with pmset/ioreg fallbacks; no desktop-Mac false detection.
— CPU monitoring on a background queue with batched UI updates; SMC key cache; debounced menubar refresh; narrower SwiftUI observation in the monitor tab.
— full source on GitHub (install-rNitro.sh, build scripts, Linux/Windows companions); slim repo with binaries on Releases only.
— brew tap ilikemacos/rnitro && brew install rnitro.

compare.title: Stable vs Beta — which should I download?
compare.subtitle: New here? Start with the green Recommended Download (App ZIP). v8.3.2 Final is production-ready with Settings subtabs; v8.3.4 Beta adds every AI provider and experimental features. Linux v0.1 pre-release is on the Linux tab; Windows is deprecated but downloads remain.

rows.stable: Subtabs: AI, Appearance, Menubar, Monitor, Alerts, General

rows.beta: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, Hermes

releases.title: Website — Windows end of support
releases.body_html: Windows deprecated — rNitro is no longer actively developed for Windows. The last build (v4.2.2-Windows-Final-x86) stays on the Windows tab and GitHub for download. New platforms: Linux v0.1 pre-release (Linux tab + GitHub Releases).

releases.title: v4.2.2-Windows-Final-x86
releases.body_html: Patched major bugs — version bump aligned with macOS v8.2.6/v8.2.7 website fixes. Windows tray monitor unchanged; download buttons on the site work again.
